{{Quote|We apologize for the misunderstanding, ''Millennium Falcon'', but you did stray into the free-fire zone.|Unidentified officer of Aegel Squadron to Han Solo|<ref name="apocalypse" />}}
An '''unidentified female Hapan''' served as an officer in [[Aegel Squadron]], a [[Hapan]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] consisting of [[Miy'til starfighter]]s, in the [[Hapan Royal Navy]]. In [[44 ABY]], the Aegels participated in the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] of the [[New Jedi Order]] from the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], after the [[Jedi academy|academy]] came under attack by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. During the evacuation, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] strayed into the free-fire zone, prompting Aegel Squadron into firing. Hapan agent [[Taryn Zel]], who was aboard the ''Millennium Falcon'', sent a message in ancient [[Lorellian language|Lorellian]] to the Aegel Squadron officer and quickly cleared the misunderstanding.<ref name="apocalypse" />
